scope: one explicit worker record and one relative target
pre_action_refusals: worker is not a single path component
target is absolute, empty, dotted, or traversing
worker root, worker record, target, evidence, or any path component is missing/unsafe
target is worker root, outside worker, or overlaps evidence
worker lacks a regular ended marker, has running/KEEP/active marker, or has a matching manager lease
evidence/manifest.json is missing/invalid, evidence path escapes, or content/mode hash differs
target contains a symlink, unsupported entry, protected marker, or archive collision exists
execution_guards: exclusive flock on the worker directory
O_NOFOLLOW directory opens for target components
recursive removal uses dirfd unlink/rmdir without following symlinks
archive publication uses a no-overwrite hard link
preservation: evidence and evidence/manifest.json are never below the removal target
pack keeps the verified <target-name>.tgz and durable worker/staging-drop.log
fallback keeps evidence and logs original bytes, full-listing SHA-256, manifest digest, and action outside target
archive and target-missing repeats refuse without a broad sweep
